# Gaius Caesar's Eastern Settlement; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; recipient=ARM
antq_m10.1000 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10.1000.title
	desc = antq_m10.1000.desc
	outcome = neutral
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_gaius_eastern_settlement.dds"
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1000.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_gaius_eastern_settlement_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_professional_standing_armies }
			add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1000.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_gaius_eastern_settlement_compact_path
		add_gold = -16
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1000.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_gaius_eastern_settlement_command_path
		add_gold = -10
		add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -1.5 }
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

antq_m10.1003 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10.1003.title
	desc = antq_m10.1003.desc
	outcome = negative
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_teutoburg.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XAA
		from = 9.8.8
		to = 10.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	trigger = {
		antq_teutoburg_campaign_ready_trigger = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = antq_teutoburg_battle_resolved }
	}
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:CRU is_at_war_with = c:CRU }
			c:CRU = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:XBL is_at_war_with = c:XBL }
			c:XBL = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:XDW is_at_war_with = c:XDW }
			c:XDW = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:XBK is_at_war_with = c:XBK }
			c:XBK = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:SEM is_at_war_with = c:SEM }
			c:SEM = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:BTV is_at_war_with = c:BTV }
			c:BTV = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:XBM is_at_war_with = c:XBM }
			c:XBM = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:SGM is_at_war_with = c:SGM }
			c:SGM = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:XBN is_at_war_with = c:XBN }
			c:XBN = { save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
			set_variable = { name = antq_teutoburg_opponent value = scope:antq_teutoburg_selected_opponent }
		}
		set_variable = antq_teutoburg_battle_resolved
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_teutoburg_chain_active } remove_variable = antq_teutoburg_chain_active }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = antq_teutoburg_varus }
			var:antq_teutoburg_varus = {
				remove_character_modifier = antq_m6_historical_lifespan_guard
				save_scope_as = antq_teutoburg_departing_varus
			}
			kill_character_silently = scope:antq_teutoburg_departing_varus
			remove_variable = antq_teutoburg_varus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1003.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_teutoburg_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -3 }
		add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_severe_bonus
		add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
		var:antq_teutoburg_opponent ?= {
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
		}
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_civic_associations }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1003.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_teutoburg_compact_path
		add_gold = -18
		add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -1 }

# Christianity Founded; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; recipient=JUD
antq_m10.1009 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10.1009.title
	desc = antq_m10.1009.desc
	outcome = neutral
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_christianity_foundation.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = JUD
		from = 30.1.1
		to = 34.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1009.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_christianity_foundation_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		religion:antq_early_christianity = {
			enable_religion = yes
			create_holy_site = { name = antq_christian_jerusalem_memory type = pilgrimage_city importance = 5 location = location:jerusalem religions = { religion:antq_early_christianity } }
			create_holy_site = { name = antq_christian_antioch_community type = pilgrimage_city importance = 4 location = location:antioch religions = { religion:antq_early_christianity } }
			create_holy_site = { name = antq_christian_ephesos_community type = pilgrimage_city importance = 3 location = location:ayasuluk religions = { religion:antq_early_christianity } }
			create_holy_site = { name = antq_christian_roman_memory type = pilgrimage_city importance = 5 location = location:rome religions = { religion:antq_early_christianity } }
		}
		# The AD 30 current seeds a small Jerusalem community; it does not convert Judea.
		location:jerusalem = {
			every_pop = {
				limit = { religion = religion:antq_judaism }
				split_pop = { fraction = 0.02 religion = religion:antq_early_christianity }
			}
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_civic_associations }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1009.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_christianity_foundation_compact_path
		add_gold = -18
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1009.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_christianity_foundation_command_path
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Xiongnu Split; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; IRAN-XIO; recipient=XIO
antq_m10.1013 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10.1013.title
	desc = antq_m10.1013.desc
	outcome = positive
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_xiongnu_split.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XIO
		from = 48.1.1
		to = 49.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1013.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_xiongnu_split_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		# Northern slice: IRAN-XIO; local M3 coordinate proxy, documented in docs/m10/.
		location:anaa = {
			create_country_from_location = {
				define_unique_country_tag = XNO
				change_country_name = XNO
				change_country_adjective = XNO
				change_country_color = map_XNO
				change_country_flag = XNO
				change_culture = ROOT.culture
				change_religion = ROOT.religion
				change_government_type = government_type:steppe_horde
				add_reform = government_reform:antq_steppe_confederation
				change_heir_selection = heir_selection:tribal_oldest_male
			}
			add_core = c:XNO
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:khurbe
					this = location:ude_baikal
					this = location:selenge
					this = location:khudan
					this = location:bureen
					this = location:khilgo
					this = location:ulenkhe
					this = location:khimni
					this = location:khilgoson
					this = location:sulkhari
					this = location:non
					this = location:ung
					this = location:gan
					this = location:uur
					this = location:zed
					this = location:dobkuri
					this = location:khatgal
					this = location:zelterijin
					this = location:kyakhta
					this = location:tsokh
					this = location:ulaamgom
					this = location:delger_moron
					this = location:menlu
					this = location:eringiin
					this = location:nuomin
					this = location:tsagaan_usun
					this = location:khadanzaa
					this = location:alyanbulag
					this = location:erzin
					this = location:turuum
					this = location:kuile
					this = location:khan_khentii
					this = location:altan_gadas
					this = location:tarvagatai
					this = location:dzaigil
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = c:XNO
			add_core = c:XNO
		}
		change_tag_cosmetic = { tag = XSO }
		add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_imperial_cult }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1013.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_xiongnu_split_compact_path
		add_gold = -20
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1013.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_xiongnu_split_command_path
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Destruction of the Second Temple; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; OCD-JER; recipient=JUD
antq_m10.1023 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10.1023.title
	desc = antq_m10.1023.desc
	outcome = negative
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_second_temple_destruction.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = JUD
		from = 70.1.1
		to = 71.1.1
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1023.a
		historical_option = yes
		set_variable = antq_m10_second_temple_destruction_chronicle_path
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		location:jerusalem = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = antq_second_temple_jerusalem }
				destroy_building = "building(building_type:antq_second_temple_jerusalem|owner)"
			}
		}
		add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_civic_associations }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1023.b
		set_variable = antq_m10_second_temple_destruction_compact_path
		add_gold = -18
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1023.c
		set_variable = antq_m10_second_temple_destruction_command_path
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Counterfactual Germania policy; derived from the end of the sourced Teutoburg window.
antq_m10.1099 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10.1099.title
	desc = antq_m10.1099.desc
	outcome = neutral
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_immensum_bellum.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XAA
		from = 10.1.2
		to = 11.1.2
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = antq_teutoburg_battle_resolved }
		NOT = { has_variable = antq_teutoburg_policy_resolved }
	}
	immediate = {
		set_variable = antq_teutoburg_policy_resolved
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = antq_teutoburg_varus }
			var:antq_teutoburg_varus = {
				remove_character_modifier = antq_m6_historical_lifespan_guard
			}
			remove_variable = antq_teutoburg_varus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1099.a
		historical_option = yes
		add_gold = -12
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1099.b
		add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -1 }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10.1099.c
		add_gold = -16
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}
}
